name: LibreChat
description: Self-hosted multi-user chat platform with configurable Agents that use files, skills, code workers and subagents.
whatItDoes: Teams run their own chat service and create Agents that can inspect and edit files in attached workspaces, run Bash under approval controls and launch background tools or subagents. A beta management API creates and updates Agents programmatically.
howItWorks: A web application hosts conversations and an Agents layer on top of the configured model endpoints. Per-user controls set whether file writes and commands are asked, allowed or denied. Setup steps are in the project documentation rather than the README.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Credentials for the model endpoints you enable
